review_title: Wrong-level and wrong-site spine surgery: mechanisms, the imaging step that fails, and decision support - a scoping review
framework: PCC (population, concept, context), JBI scoping review guidance; reported per PRISMA-ScR

population.statement: Human patients undergoing spine surgery or a spinal intervention, or imaging studies of vertebral enumeration.

concept.statement: A wrong-level or wrong-site event, its mechanism, its frequency, the imaging step used to determine level, or a method intended to prevent it, including transitional-anatomy detection and vertebral numbering.

context.statement: Any clinical setting, any country, any year, English or any language with an English abstract. No context restriction is applied by the screen.

exclusions.E_NOT_SPINE: The record does not concern the spine at all (no spine, vertebral or spinal-region term).
exclusions.E_NON_SPINE_WRONG_SITE: Wrong-site surgery outside the spine (wrong-site language with no spine term).
exclusions.E_ANIMAL_CADAVER: Animal or cadaver-only work with no clinical claim.
exclusions.E_EDITORIAL_NO_DATA: Editorial, comment, letter, erratum or news item with no data.
exclusions.E_NO_FULLTEXT: No retrievable abstract or full text in the held corpus.
exclusions.E_NO_CONCEPT: Spine record with no wrong-level, level-determination, enumeration or transitional-anatomy claim.
exclusions.E_TECHNICAL_NO_LEVEL_CLAIM: Purely technical imaging paper with no level-determination claim.
exclusions.E_NO_POPULATION: No human patient, clinical or imaging-of-enumeration population.
exclusions.E_PROCEEDINGS_COLLECTION: A conference proceedings container (a block of abstracts), not a chartable record.

screening_stages.evidence: title, journal and publication type (the only fields held for every record)
screening_stages.note: Screened liberally: a spine title with no concept term is carried forward rather than excluded, because a four-word title is not evidence of absence.

screening_stages.evidence: mined full-text passages, figure captions, PDF text

sources.europepmc: FluoroCap_lstv/articles.jsonl - the review's primary search (Europe PMC full-text query)
sources.semanticscholar: FluoroCap_s2/s2_works.jsonl - second source for the same question
